title: What I Think, and Why
label: ch:ja-what-i-think-and-why
canDo: I can say what I think with a plain clause and to omoimasu, ask dō omoimasu ka, give a reason with kara or node, and say who suggested something (iidashimashita).

payoff.summary: Complete JA-R254-what-i-think-and-why: say what you think and why, and ask someone else's opinion.
